reason: The task spec. Class A / Class B split, the six implementation decisions, the full synchronisation list for the resolve_base_url rename, and the ten acceptance criteria.
The decision being implemented. Partially supersedes ADR 0005 section 6 — read this one for what LLM_BASE_URL now accepts, not the old one.

Still binding except for section 6: no runtime probing (5), no silent fallback (4), 404/401/403 belong to CATEGORY_ENDPOINT_CONFIG (7), and one adapter module per protocol with dispatch happening exactly once (8). Section 6 is superseded by ADR 0006.

Glossary. Classifier Endpoint is now 'derived from' LLM_BASE_URL, not 'configured by' it — the domain concept is still always an API root. LLM Protocol and Schema Mode definitions are unchanged. Use these words.

Holds the failure matrix, the Good/Base/Bad cases and the Tests Required list for configuration. Three rows about LLM_BASE_URL suffixes and one Bad case (anthropic + /v1) flip from reject to tolerate — this file must be updated in the same change, not after.

The new WARNING must obey this: bounded literals only. The suffix comes from ENDPOINT_SUFFIX (a fixed set) and the protocol name is an enum value, so both are loggable; the URL, model and key are never loggable. Lazy %s formatting, not f-strings.

Why every configuration failure must leave config.py as RuntimeError and never ValueError: that is the only type run_sync catches around load_settings, and run_sync promises never to raise. resolve_base_url raises ValueError; config.py must keep translating it.

llm/ is stdlib-only and may not import classifier; llm/__init__.py must not re-export the adapter modules (get_adapter imports them inside the function to protect the 1 s startup budget). Adding resolve_base_url to the exports must not disturb that.
The forbidden-pattern table and the commands that gate this change: uv run pytest backend/tests, uv run ruff check backend/, uv run ruff format --check backend/.

This change is net-negative in code: three FORBIDDEN_BASE_SUFFIXES declarations and one WireAdapter member are deleted because the Class A set is derived from ENDPOINT_SUFFIX. If the implementation ends up adding branches instead of removing them, it has gone wrong.
Python Workers runtime rules that only fail after deploy: env is attribute-access-only, keep global scope cheap, no module-level import that is not needed by fetch/scheduled.
